fix_note: Episode 2 picture pass: 16 must-fix entries fixed by redrawing 13 stills with the full-quality engine (3-4 takes each, every hand checked at 3x), plus 5 minor redraws (indio_sad, indio_hungry, sepoy_farmer, coins, phone) and a 4 px trim of full/city.jpg. cast_fix applied first (character nv_replace entries removed, no-dog clause added). The redraws settle Indio on the tousled-topknot, brown-eyed look of k00/k47; k03, k09 and k45 stay in the older lean look (k45 needs_figma). Old stills in the scratch folder slop/ep02/old/. Keys recomposited with make_keys.py (keys/ is git-ignored). Checked by the conductor's checker: 19 changed stills kept (looked at old and new at full size and 3x); full/intro.jpg (k01) redraw thrown away (Usman off model, tattoo across both arms), old still restored and the four k01 entries handed to Figma. Small leftovers judged invisible on a paused phone: the k34 tattoo edge touches the lower arm, the k24 glove shows four fingers with the first two close together.
